item.title: Coca Plantations Exceed Legal Limit of 120,000 Hectares in Bolivia
item.description: The area under coca cultivation in Bolivia increased by 10% between 2023 and 2024, according to data released on Monday by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC). Coca crops covered an estimated 340,000 hectares in 2024, placing Bolivia third worldwide in coca cultivation, behind Peru and Colombia, the UN agency said.
